item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["8b24b4cb96688979807f","ae1acd2c90805a0b718e"],"operation":"Parse a four-component OBJ v line in parseVertexWithColor and LoadObj.","condition":"The v line has a single fourth component after its position coordinates.","capability":"Retain that component in vertex_weights and publish it in the output attributes.","consequence":"The vertex weight is lost or not published.","equivalence_reason":"Both candidates describe the same fourth-component parsing and vertex_weights output behavior."},{"member_ids":["8223b9b9211883698acc","a90ba499dcabf01f784a"],"operation":"Parse an OBJ vertex through LoadObj with config.vertex_color controlling color fallback.","condition":"config.vertex_color disables fallback and the vertex has no RGB components.","capability":"Accept the vertex without supplying fallback colors.","consequence":"The vertex is rejected or fallback colors are supplied.","equivalence_reason":"Both candidates describe the same disabled color-fallback behavior for a vertex without RGB components."},{"member_ids":["0e87590cf03d76f5fedf","05a946dded8ffaa7454b"],"operation":"Export a polygon face through exportGroupsToShape using config.triangulate.","condition":"config.triangulate is false.","capability":"Preserve the polygon face without triangulating it, if supported.","consequence":"The polygon is triangulated or not preserved as a polygon face.","equivalence_reason":"Both candidates describe the same conditional polygon-export behavior."}]}
